$comment: DRAFT, in preparation. The network-facing provider agent SmartCiti.X, prepared for the Virtuals agent platform's Agent Commerce Protocol as the owner's acp-cli repository describes it (README.md, SKILL.md, docs/tokenization.md at commit 9aa61ae). Nothing here is live: no agent created, no offering published, no wallet, no signer, no token. Same worker/function shape as agents/foreman/agent.json, which it extends: Foreman stays on the learner's device; SmartCiti.X reuses only the functions that carry no personal data. No keys, no endpoints, no wallet addresses, no prices, no network code. Validated by tools/check_virtuals.mjs; see docs/virtuals/strategy.md.
name: SmartCiti.X

token.note: The agent token name the owner chose. No token exists. Any launch is the owner's decision, after legal review, per acp-cli docs/tokenization.md; see agents/smartcitix/runbook.md. No price, supply, fee, valuation or return is stated or implied anywhere in this package.

extends.relation: SmartCiti.X is Foreman's provider face on the agent network. It reuses Foreman's registry and simulation functions and adds a lesson service; Foreman's passport-reading functions stay on the device and are listed under onDeviceOnly, never offered.

goal: Offer the Holodeck's robotics training to other agents as provider jobs: evaluate a robot or agent policy on a station in simulation, supply curated robot-skill datasets with their licence and consent fields, answer curriculum and skill-registry queries, and compose lessons from real stations — without ever moving personal data or training records off a learner's device.
description: SmartCiti.X is the SmartCiti.X Holodeck's agent for the agent network. It answers jobs from the skill registry (every station as a task graph of robot primitives with preconditions and failure labels), the procedure engine a learner is scored by, the dataset exporter and the lesson composer. Every deliverable is evidence of a procedure under this engine's scoring, in simulation, and is not a certification.
constraints: Nothing on-chain, nothing signed, nothing sent from this repository; the owner runs agents/smartcitix/runbook.md.
No personal data and no training records in any requirement, deliverable, message or resource; only synthetic rollouts, or episodes a learner chose to export with permission to distribute.
A station a robot runs is run in simulation; a step a station marks noRobot is handed to a person, never attempted.
Passing here is evidence of a procedure, not a credential.
Every protocol detail beyond acp-cli's own files is to verify against the official docs before use.

acp.source: AGIFutureFoundation/acp-cli README.md and SKILL.md at commit 9aa61ae

passport.note: Read on the learner's device only, by Foreman; never an input to or output of a SmartCiti.X job.

workers.description: Runs a policy through a station on the real procedure engine in simulation and reports the engine's own summary.
Builds dataset slices in the native, LeRobot-style and RLDS-style layouts from synthetic rollouts, carrying the licence and consent fields.
Answers programme and station queries from the skill registry, and composes lessons from real stations.

functions.name: evaluate_station
functions.description: Run a policy through a station in simulation and return the engine's summary: score, stars, unsafe actions, holds broken, pass or fail. Deterministic for a seed. Locally the policy is the reference robot agent at a given skill.

stationId.description: A station id in the skill registry, e.g. electrical.

functions.name: export_skill_dataset
functions.description: A curated slice of synthetic robot-skill episodes in native, LeRobot-style and RLDS-style layouts, with the manifest's licence and consent fields.

functions.name: curriculum_query
functions.description: The stations of a programme, or one station's task graph with its preconditions and failure labels.

functions.name: compose_lesson
functions.description: A lesson composed from real stations for a sentence, with a reason for the order and a pass bar.
